items.title: Detect stale verificationEvidence at user-visible entry points
items.context: session_brief, story_advance pre-check (REVIEW/TEST/DONE), and koala validate output must compare current materialHash / headHash with stored evidence and flag stale rows explicitly. The flag must read as 'EVIDENCE STALE (materialHash drift after <sha>)' rather than a generic validation failure. Reuse existing freshness check, do not re-implement.

items.title: Print copy-paste recovery commands in stale-evidence output
items.context: Every stale flag must be followed by the exact CLI lines that resolve it for this story: e.g., 'koala verification_evidence_refresh_stale --storyId=B-xxx' then 'koala validate --story=B-xxx --json'. Lines must use the actual storyId, not placeholders, so users copy and run without editing. Output goes into session_brief footer, story_advance hint surface, and koala validate trailing block.

items.title: Add a single-shot recover command that does refresh + revalidate
items.context: Provide 'koala recover_evidence --storyId=B-xxx' (or accept an existing entry point name) that runs verification_evidence_refresh_stale then validate in one go, prints both transcripts, and exits non-zero if validate still fails. The command must refuse to run if there are non-koala_metadata dirty files (material/fixture/unexpected) so it cannot mask real drift.

items.title: Regression-prove the stale UX with a simulated main-merge scenario
items.context: Add a smoke test that writes verificationEvidence, mutates a referenced material source file to break materialHash, then asserts: session_brief output, story_advance output, and koala validate output all contain the literal 'EVIDENCE STALE' marker followed by a copy-paste line including the storyId; recover_evidence command refreshes the evidence and revalidate passes; recover_evidence refuses when an unexpected_dirty_files path exists.
